text.description_html:
Acorn SCBBG, Solid Black Half Round Knob

Door knobs with a solid black finish are not easy to find especially of this quality. Good for both exterior and interior use, it is easy to install and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. Made by Acorn, it will fit standard pre-drilled doors with either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets with door thicknesses of 1-3/4"to 1-3/8". Available in single dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions.

Features of the Solid Black Half Round Knobset:

  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors with 2-1/8" crossbores and 15/16" edgebores.
  • Complete with rose and reversible tubular latch.
  • The cylinder of the Keyed Entry Function is solid brass with a 5 pin tumbler and nickel pins.
  • Keyed Entry Function has a Schlage Type keyway.

Specifications of the Solid Smooth Black Half Round Knob:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: A stationary knob for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Complete set - 1 knob, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior knob engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior knob. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Keyed Entry (keyed lock): Use when a lock operated by a key is needed. Unlocked by key from the outside. From the inside, the deadlatch is thrown and retracted by a turn button in the center of the knob. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, mounting screws, and key.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
